title: Vienna Applied Microeconomics Network
text:
We are a group of Vienna-based researchers working on topics in Labour and Applied Micro Economics, with the aim of meeting frequently to discuss research and policy, and to present our work. Our calendar provides information on research events and seminars taking place in Vienna on Labour and Applied Micro topics. Our monthly meetup takes place on the first Monday evening of each month during the academic year. During our annual workshop, we present ongoing research on a broad range of Applied Economics topics


The Vienna Applied Micro Economics Network is a joint initiative of the Central European University, the University of Vienna, and the Vienna University of Economics and Business.
​

title: Workshop
text:
We organise an annual workshop to share recent research on a broad range of Applied Economics topics and to meet with other researchers in Vienna.

Our fourth annual Vienna Applied Micro Economics Workshop will take place at the Central European University on October 16, 2026.
